## `client.tokens`

The `tokens` (PAT) resource of the platform API, nested under a principal.

### `client.tokens.issue`

Signature: `client.tokens.issue(principal: str, name: str) -> IssuedToken`

Issue a PAT for a principal.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `principal` | `str` | required | The principal the PAT authenticates as. |
| `name` | `str` | required | A human label for this PAT (e.g. `"laptop"`, `"CI"`). |

Returns: `IssuedToken`. The full token value — shown here exactly once.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If no principal of this name exists. |

### `client.tokens.list`

Signature: `client.tokens.list(principal: str) -> list[Token]`

List every PAT issued to a principal. Never includes a secret.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `principal` | `str` | required | The principal whose PATs to list. |

Returns: `list of Token`. Every PAT for that principal.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If no principal of this name exists. |

### `client.tokens.revoke`

Signature: `client.tokens.revoke(principal: str, key_id: str) -> None`

Revoke a PAT.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `principal` | `str` | required | The principal the PAT belongs to. |
| `key_id` | `str` | required | The PAT's key_id. |

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If no principal or PAT of these identifiers exists. |
